payload.instruction: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Transform the original black DVD into a white DVD, preserving it as the same recognizable disc object with its center hole.
outcome.target: The DVD originally near the center of the source image, between the shoe at lower left and the dark object at right, is transformed so its disc surface is white while retaining its recognizable DVD form and center hole. A separate white disc or a white object elsewhere does not fulfill the request.
outcome.reference: In the source image, the DVD is the small rectangular-looking disc/package near the center, just right of the shoe and left of the dark object. Use its source location and identity to distinguish it from the dark object at right and any newly added objects.

check.question: Has the original black DVD been transformed into a white DVD?
check.complete_when: The same DVD at its source location has a visibly white disc surface and remains recognizable as a DVD, including its disc shape and center hole.
check.partial_when: The original DVD is identifiable at its source location and some of its surface has visibly changed toward white, but it is not fully white or its recognizable DVD form is not clearly preserved.
check.absent_when: The original DVD remains black with no visible progress toward white, is missing or unchanged, or the edit only adds a separate white disc/object while leaving the original untransformed. A white disc at another location does not count.
check.unknown_when: The original DVD cannot be confidently identified in the edited image, or its color and transformation cannot be assessed from the available images.

response.content: {"status":"absent","evidence":"The original DVD/package at the center-left source location is no longer identifiable as a disc; the edited image shows a separate white disc there, while the dark object at right has also become disc-like. parsed.evidence: The original DVD/package at the center-left source location is no longer identifiable as a disc; the edited image shows a separate white disc there, while the dark object at right has also become disc-like.
